4272.title: Connect settings do not recover missed status updates
4272.rootCauseOneLine: Connect settings fetch on mount and status signals but never refetch after realtime connectivity recovers.
4272.proposedFix: Refetch through the existing connection-state hook when realtime returns to connected.
4272.caveats: A missed signal was simulated at the real component boundary; no live tunnel outage or original two-machine incident was reproduced.
